gloss: anman; steamed bun with sweet red bean filling

definitions.gloss: steamed bun filled with sweet red bean paste
definitions.explanation: A soft white steamed bun with a sweet {餡|あん} (red bean paste) filling. Sold hot at convenience stores in winter alongside the savory {肉|にく}まん.

examples.japanese: あんまん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あんまん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたく→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On cold days I start wanting an anman.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あんまん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肉|にく}まん→肉まん：28810_nikuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I bought one anman and one nikuman at the convenience store and headed home.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ (sweet bean paste) + まん, a shortening of ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧. Usually written in kana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あんまん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧: to steam an anman
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧あんまん: a warm anman
- あんまん⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one anman (ordering at a counter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉|にく}まん→肉まん：28810_nikuman⟧: steamed pork bun — the savory counterpart, sold side by side
- ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}まん→中華まん：30274_chuukaman⟧: Chinese-style steamed bun — the category term covering both
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: manju — a broader class of bean-filled confections, not necessarily steamed hot for eating on the spot
